text:
nora_prodops: Heads-up: we opened an early-access Dedicated H100v3 pool in eu-west-1 (Ireland) for customers on enterprise contracts.

This is a limited-capacity preview to validate performance and placement policies before a public launch. Key points below. :sparkles:

alex_infra: Pool details live in infra-config: `infra-config/services/dedicated/pools/eu-west-1/h100v3-preview.yaml`

```yaml
pool_name: h100v3-preview-eu-ire
capacity: 24 gpus
availability: limited_preview
allocation_policy: reserved-first
burst_options: disabled
note: "early access; customer slots by invite only"
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v1.39 deployed by alex_infra 1:12UTC 184688001 :white_check_mark:

mohit_sales: What's the expected latency profile vs H100v2? Any quantized/FP8 guidance for customers?

alex_infra: Early numbers: median token latency ~6% better than H100v2 under our standard seq=512 workload. We recommend FP8 for best throughput; we'll publish microbenchmarks tomorrow.

jenna_security: Reminder: Private deployments with customer-managed KMS are required for the preview. No shared key SKU permitted. Also enabling audit logs for all preview reservations.

liam_euops: Capacity will be allocated by invite; EU sales sent an invite list this morning. We have 24 GPUs spread across 3 racks; network egress limits applied to reduce noisy neighbor risk. Monitoring hooks added to the console under "Dedicated -> Pools -> h100v3-preview".

nora_prodops: Customer-facing messaging: explicit limited preview language, expected SLAs are best-effort until GA, and we will surface model compatibility notes. Draft for #support: "We're running a limited preview of H100v3 Dedicated pools in eu-west-1 for eligible customers. If you're interested, contact your account team. Performance and availability are being monitored closely during the preview."

mohit_sales: Pricing for preview customers? We should discount onboardings and waive first-month commitment. Will coordinate with finance.

alex_infra: Ops safety: auto-drain policy is in place if thermal or perf thresholds exceed safe limits; drains will preserve existing reservations and only block new ones. Alert thresholds: `gpu_temp_avg>85C`, `nvlink_error_rate>0.1%`, `drv_err_rate>0.05%`.

status-bot: Status updated: "H100v3 dedicated preview (eu-west-1) opened for invited customers. Monitoring enabled."

nora_prodops: Timeline: preview open now, validation window ~2 weeks, then decide GA target. Will post microbenchmarks, billing guidance, and runbook links in #announcements tomorrow. :calendar: 

liam_euops: Oncall rota for the preview: liam_euops, alex_infra, and amanda_sre. Please monitor the console metrics dash: `dedicated.h100v3.preview.*`.

jenna_security: Also flagging SOC review scheduled for next Tue. If any customer requests expanded access before that, escalate to security.

mohit_sales: Great. I'll prep comms for invited customers and coordinate discounts.

nora_prodops: Thanks all. Ping me directly for invites or if you want to shadow the preview stats.
